name: vista-compass
description: A compass for VistA's code. Point it at any .m routine to get your bearings, then click any reference, call-in, call-out, global, or XINDEX finding to navigate through all of VistA's interconnected web of routines, FileMan files, pointers, RPCs, options, protocols, and globals. Every row in the sidebar is a clickable jump. Drawn from vista-meta code-model TSVs. No language server, no parser, no runtime deps.

vistaCompass.dataPath.description: Path to a vista-meta data ROOT: a directory holding code-model/ and data-model/ — the repo's vista/export tree or an unpacked vista-meta-data-v1 release bundle. Absolute, ~-prefixed, or workspace-relative. Empty = auto-discover (vista/export, then vista-meta-data-v1, walking up from the active file).

vistaCompass.codeModelPath.description: DEPRECATED — use vistaCompass.dataPath (a data root) instead. Workspace-relative path to the code-model TSV directory; kept as a fallback.

vistaCompass.vistaMHostPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the synced VistA-M host tree.

vistaCompass.topN.description: Maximum entries to show in each section (callers, callees, etc.).
